# Adversarial review, 2026-10-15

**Method.** A separate reviewer with fresh context, given only the repository and the hard constraints (traceable numbers, three labels, pre registration, generated files, no claimed partnership, writing rules, all rights reserved, no PDFs or secrets), read the repository at commits 05ca1cd to e37bafb and reported 38 findings with file and line. It had no edit rights. The builder also ran mechanical scans (dash characters, an excluded institution name, tool names, build machine paths, hyphenated compounds, stale statements). The reviewer is a language model agent, so shared blind spots with the builder are possible; a human read of the report remains advisable.

Status: FIXED (commit given), NOT FIXED (reason given). Line numbers refer to the reviewed commit.
